title: Market Signal: Morning Reversal Alert — July 14, 2026
summary: After an initial flat open and brief bounce, the Korea market triggered a morning reversal pattern — early gains were fully erased by 09:45, confirming downward pressure continues after Monday's heavy decline.
key_points: KOSPI opened flat near 6,800, briefly recovered to 6,823 by 09:37, then reversed sharply to 6,722 by 09:45 — a morning reversal pattern.
Semiconductor divergence: Samsung Electronics held positive (+1.77%) but faded from +3.93% peak. SK Hynix flipped from positive to -2.11%.
KOSDAQ -2.73% underperforming significantly with mid/small-cap delayed adjustment after Monday's crash.
Oil remains elevated (WTI ~$79.83), but the won is stable (USD/KRW 1,497.58) — no currency crisis signal.
External conditions: US S&P500 futures stable in Asian trading. No new external shock driving the reversal.
source_caveat: Market index data from public Korean exchange real-time feeds. Commodity and currency data from delayed public sources. All figures indicative. KOSPI200 direct futures unavailable; KODEX200 proxy used.
limitations: This is a market observation note, not investment advice.
